note: The scripted demo (S5). Film time in seconds. cmds drive the real page (solver log, views, sliders, knob); camera / spot / captions are the film's own layers. Selectors are elements of xray.html; a camera 'fit' frames the union of its selectors.

captions.zh: 10 毫秒，就能拍下一张胸片。
captions.en: 10 milliseconds is all it takes to make a chest X-ray.

captions.zh: 这是怎么做到的？靠的就是这根 47.6 厘米长的 X 光管。
captions.en: How is that possible? It starts with this X-ray tube, 47.6 cm long.

captions.zh: 剖开来看，左边的灯丝烧到白热，就会放出电子。
captions.en: Cut it open, and the filament on the left glows white-hot, giving off electrons.

captions.zh: 右边的钨靶盘也转了起来，每分钟高达 9 700 转。
captions.en: On the right, the tungsten disc spins up, to 9,700 turns a minute.

say.zh: 右边的钨靶盘也转了起来，每分钟高达九千七百转。
say.en: On the right, the tungsten disc spins up, to nine thousand seven hundred turns a minute.

captions.zh: 高压把电子拉向靶盘，速度能达到光速的一半。
captions.en: High voltage pulls the electrons across, at up to half the speed of light.

captions.zh: 电子撞上钨，猛地刹住，刹车的能量就变成了 X 光。
captions.en: They slam into the tungsten and stop, and that braking energy comes out as X-rays.

captions.zh: 电压越高，X 光就越硬，穿透力也越强。
captions.en: Higher voltage means harder X-rays, which get through more.

captions.zh: 电压超过了 69.5 千伏，光谱上还会冒出钨特有的指纹。
captions.en: Above 69.5 kV, tungsten’s own fingerprint shows up in the spectrum.

say.en: Above sixty-nine point five kilovolts, tungsten's own fingerprint shows up in the spectrum.

captions.zh: 但只有不到 1% 变成 X 光，剩下的全变成了热。
captions.en: But less than 1 % becomes X-rays. The rest all turns to heat.

say.en: But less than one percent becomes X-rays. The rest all turns to heat.

captions.zh: 所以靶盘得一直转，把热分散到一整圈上。
captions.en: So the disc keeps spinning, spreading the heat round a whole ring.

captions.zh: 焦点能烧到两千多度，但钨要 3 422 °C 才会熔。
captions.en: The focal spot can pass 2,000 °C, but tungsten won’t melt until 3,422 °C.

say.zh: 焦点能烧到两千多度，但钨要3422度才会熔。
say.en: The focal spot can pass two thousand degrees, but tungsten won't melt until three thousand four hundred and twenty-two.

captions.zh: 满功率开上 2.8 秒，靶盘就再也装不下热了。
captions.en: At full power, the disc can only take 2.8 seconds before it’s full of heat.

say.en: At full power, the disc can only take two point eight seconds before it's full of heat.

captions.zh: 一旦超过额定值，机器就不让曝光了。
captions.en: Go past the rating, and the machine simply won’t fire.

say.en: Go past the rating, and the machine simply won't fire.

captions.zh: 拆开看：外面是管套和油，里面是真空管、阴极、靶盘和转子。
captions.en: Take it apart. Outside are the housing and the oil. Inside is the vacuum tube, with the cathode, the disc and the rotor.

captions.zh: X 光穿过身体，落在后面的探测板上。
captions.en: The X-rays pass through the body and land on the detector behind it.

captions.zh: 骨头挡得多就发白，肺里全是空气就发黑。
captions.en: Bone blocks more, so it shows up white. The lungs are full of air, so they show black.

captions.zh: 电压调高，骨头变淡，肺部纹理反而更清楚。
captions.en: Turn the voltage up, and bone fades while lung detail gets clearer.

captions.zh: 所以拍胸片，一般用 120 千伏的高电压。
captions.en: That’s why chest X-rays are usually taken at a high 120 kV.

say.en: That's why chest X-rays are usually taken at a high one hundred and twenty kilovolts.

captions.zh: 剖面影像工坊，让看不见的原理被看见。
captions.en: Cutaway Works. Making the invisible visible.
